# Stormcage

> Cross-Agent Context & Memory Firewall (Roshar Fabrial Archetype).

## Core Capabilities
- Context & Memory Firewall: Prevents Cross-Agent Persistent Prompt Injections (OWASP LLM01) across shared agent memory pools, scratchpads, and context windows.
- Semantic Taint Tracker: Manages provenance flags (`TRUST_LOCAL_WORKSPACE`, `TAINT_EXTERNAL_USER`, `TAINT_UNTRUSTED_WEB`) and privilege gating.
- AST Normalizer & Stripper: NFKC unicode decomposition, zero-width rune removal (`U+200B..U+200F`, `U+FEFF`), HTML comment flattening, and Base64/Hex payload extraction.
- Multi-Tier Injection Detector: Static OWASP LLM01 rules, imperative verb density scoring, and semantic intent-drift vector tracking.
- Verdict Cache: SHA-256 hashed cache for <0.5ms repeat evaluation.

## CLI Usage
- `stormcage scan --input "<text>"`: Scans input for prompt injection or system override attacks.
- `stormcage sanitize --input "<text>"`: Strips hidden runes and normalizes text.
- `stormcage daemon --port 8181 --socket ~/.stormcage/stormcage.sock`: Starts HTTP/socket firewall daemon.

## Sockets & Documentation
- Daemon Socket: `~/.stormcage/stormcage.sock`
- Documentation: `docs/knowledge-base/08-stormcage.md` in repo `spanreed`
